findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now extends StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of its abstract members (counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and the newly added build_occurrence_and_event_data). Detector.detector_handler does `group_type.detector_handler(self)`, so any Detector with type `metric_alert_fire` will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class ...` instead of the previous no-op handler returning an empty result. process_detectors has no exception handling around handler construction/evaluation, so this can abort processing for the whole batch.

findings.title: Stateful evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate now returns `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]`, but its docstring at line 230 still says it returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult. This misdocuments the new contract that this PR is explicitly changing for callers and subclass authors.

findings.title: Mock occurrence builder ignores value so tests cannot verify value propagation
findings.body: build_mock_occurrence_and_event accepts `value` but never uses it when constructing the IssueOccurrence or event_data. Consequently the new build_occurrence_and_event_data hook's most important input is unverified: several tests even build the expected occurrence with the wrong value (e.g. test_state_results_multi_group builds group_2's expected occurrence with 6 instead of the packet value 10, and TestEvaluate builds expectations with 6 for packet values 100/8) yet still pass. A regression that passed the wrong value to the hook would not be caught.
